buildCmd: cd werewolf-client && npm run build && cd .. && node werewolf-client/design-kit/refresh-css.mjs

libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: Next.js app dirs: [id] route segments must not become component groups

dtsPropsFor.PlayerAvatar: name: string; size?: number /* px, default 32 */; isGM?: boolean; isDead?: boolean; className?: string; avatarUrl?: string /* themed portrait; falls back to initial-letter gradient */; focus?: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } /* fraction of the image to show in the circle (a framed portrait's circle); absent = legacy whole-image crop */;
dtsPropsFor.CharacterCard: game: any /* Game object: bots, humanPlayerName, gameState, avatarsStatus, avatarVariants, ... */; name: string /* participant: bot, human player, or 'Game Master' */; onClose: () => void; isOwner?: boolean; onGameChange?: (patch: any) => void; onSelectVariant?: (gameId: string, key: string, index: number) => Promise<any>; onReframe?: (gameId: string, key: string, target: number | 'mannequin', framing: any) => Promise<any> /* opens the reframe editor for the shown candidate when set */; avatarUrl?: string /* REQUIRED in designs: overrides the in-app portrait route */;
dtsPropsFor.RoleCard: role: 'werewolf' | 'doctor' | 'detective' | 'maniac' | 'villager'; own?: boolean /* true = the player's own role: 'You are the …' */; onClose: () => void; imageSrc?: string /* REQUIRED in designs: overrides /roles/<role>.jpg */;
dtsPropsFor.SelectDropdown: options: { value: string; label: string }[]; value: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; placeholder?: string; className?: string; disabled?: boolean;
dtsPropsFor.MultiSelectDropdown: options: string[]; selectedOptions: string[]; onChange: (selectedOptions: string[]) => void; placeholder?: string; className?: string; disabled?: boolean; hasError?: boolean; labelFn?: (option: string) => string; optionMetaFn?: (option: string) => { tags?: string[] } | undefined;
dtsPropsFor.ModelSelectDropdown: options: { model: string; label: string; displayLabel: string; disabled: boolean }[]; value: string /* model id */; onChange: (value: string) => void; className?: string; disabled?: boolean;
dtsPropsFor.AIModelSelect: options: string[] /* model ids */; selectedOptions: string[]; onChange: (selectedOptions: string[]) => void; placeholder?: string; className?: string; disabled?: boolean; hasError?: boolean; optionMetaFn?: (option: string) => { tags?: string[] } | undefined; onFastOnlyChange?: (fastOnly: boolean) => void;
dtsPropsFor.ExpandableTextarea: value: string; onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void; className?: string; placeholder?: string; id?: string; minHeight?: number /* collapsed height px */; 'aria-label'?: string;
dtsPropsFor.CharacterPoster: game: any /* Game object: bots, humanPlayerName, gameState, avatarsStatus, ... */; name: string /* participant: bot, human player, or 'Game Master' */; cornerChip?: React.ReactNode /* top-right chip content, e.g. a turn counter */; cost?: number /* USD, shown in the name plate when > 0 */; hideCostOnNarrow?: boolean; avatarUrl?: string /* REQUIRED in designs: overrides the in-app portrait route */; cardFocus?: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } /* with avatarUrl: show only this part of the image (a card framed on a sheet) */; className?: string;
dtsPropsFor.IllustrationsPanel: draft: { status: 'generating' | 'ready' | 'failed'; version: number; keys: string[]; avatarVariants: Record<string, { n: number; sel: number; first?: number; framing?: Record<string, { card: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }; circle: { x: number; y: number; d: number } }>; drawn?: Record<string, any> }>; avatarVersions: Record<string, number>; hasScene: boolean; stages: { portraits: boolean; scene: boolean }; error?: string | null } | null /* null = nothing drawn yet */; cast: { key: string; name: string; kind: 'bot' | 'you' | 'gm' }[]; castChanged: boolean /* set was drawn for different names */; busy: boolean /* request in flight */; error: string | null; onGenerate: () => void; locked?: boolean /* free tier: locked card with an upgrade link instead of the draw button */; upgradeHref?: string; imageUrlFn?: (key: string) => string /* REQUIRED in designs: overrides the authed draft-image route; the scene uses key 'scene-welcome' */; onPortraitClick?: (entry: { key: string; name: string; kind: 'bot' | 'you' | 'gm' }) => void /* when set, drawn portraits become clickable (opens the crop editor) */;
dtsPropsFor.ReframeModal: name: string /* header line */; sheetUrl: string /* the portrait sheet the card was cut from (REQUIRED in designs: a reachable image) */; framing: { card: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }; circle: { x: number; y: number; d: number } } /* current: card in sheet px, circle as card fractions */; initial: { card: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }; circle: { x: number; y: number; d: number } } /* what 'Reset to the drawn crop' restores */; onSave: (framing: any) => Promise<void> /* rejects → inline error, stays open */; onClose: () => void;
